cards.title: Don't Buy Grand Theft Auto VI for Your Child
cards.body: Rockstar Games' 18-rated game is stuffed with explicit sex, drugs, and violence. It's the most explicit game ever made and absolutely not appropriate for kids.

cards.title: Adult Son Back Home? Expect Role Reversal
cards.body: When graduates return to the nest due to economic pressures, parents shift from enjoying extended visits to navigating daily life together. Old parenting instincts resurface, testing patience and boundaries.

cards.title: Why Being Home Triggers Teenage Feelings
cards.body: Despite personal growth, family gatherings can make adults feel like teenagers again due to old patterns and dynamics. Personality science explains why this happens and how to manage it.

cards.title: Holidays on a Tight Budget With Kids
cards.body: Economic strain can complicate holiday gatherings and gift-giving with children. Talk openly with kids about financial challenges while working to preserve cherished family traditions.

cards.title: Blended Families: Making It Work With Exes
cards.body: Successfully navigating holidays and time with your child's half-siblings requires building rapport with their other parents. Expert guidance helps create harmony in modern blended family arrangements.

cards.title: Early Stress Rewires Your Child's Brain
cards.body: New research shows childhood stress can permanently alter how the brain responds to future stressors. Early adversity heightens sensitivity, potentially affecting lifelong mental health responses.

cards.title: Family Estrangement: Protecting Innocent Parties
cards.body: During holidays, family members uninvolved in conflicts often feel caught between estranged relatives. Understanding manipulation tactics helps protect those stuck in the middle.

cards.title: Divorce Success Requires Higher Brain Function
cards.body: Couples stuck in fight-or-flight mode experience longer, costlier, more difficult divorces. Learning to engage your higher brain creates better outcomes for everyone, especially children.
